name: Bundesdatenschutzgesetz (BDSG)
description: German Federal Data Protection Act supplementing GDPR with German-specific provisions.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Bundesministerium der Justiz / Juris (gesetze-im-internet.de) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Bundesministerium der Justiz / Juris (gesetze-im-internet.de).
